camel_example: aliyun vod UploadStreamByURL --region cn-hangzhou --MediaId ca3a8f6e490000057b65806709586 --Definition HD --StreamURL 'https://example.com/lesson-01.mp4'
description_en: Uploads a transcoded stream file from external storage and mounts it to the corresponding ApsaraVideo VOD media asset
description_zh: 上传外部存储的转码流文件并挂载到对应的点播媒资下
kebab_example: aliyun vod upload-stream-by-url --stream-url https://example.com/lesson-01.mp4 --media-id ca3a8f6e490000057b65806709586 --definition HD --region cn-hangzhou
name: UploadStreamByURL

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the transcoded stream file.

If the URL of the transcoded stream requires authentication, include the authentication parameters in StreamURL and make sure the URL is accessible through public network access.
You can obtain the audio or video URL from the console or by invoking the GetPlayInfo operation
parameters.help_zh:
转码流文件URL。

如果转码流的URL需要鉴权，需要在StreamURL中传入鉴权参数，并确保该URL可以通过公网访问。
URL可以通过控制台获取音视频的地址；也可以通过getplayinfo接口调用来获取音视频地址
parameters.name: stream_url

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ApsaraVideo VOD media asset that corresponds to the transcoded stream
parameters.help_zh: 转码流对应的点播媒资ID
parameters.name: media_id

parameters.help_en:
The definition of the video stream.

For valid values of this parameter, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/124671.html
parameters.help_zh:
视频流清晰度。

取值，详情请参考:  https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/124671.html
parameters.name: definition

parameters.help_en:
The file name extension of the transcoded stream file.

For supported audio and video file formats, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55396.html.

If this parameter is not empty, it overwrites the file name extension in the StreamURL.

<notice>This parameter is required if the StreamURL does not contain a file name extension.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
转码流文件扩展名。


扩展名请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55396.html中的音频和视频的支持文件格式。


当该参数不为空时，会覆盖StreamURL地址中的文件扩展名。

<notice>若StreamURL地址中不含文件扩展名，该参数必填。></notice>
parameters.name: file_extension

parameters.help_en:
The HDR type of the transcoded stream. Valid values:
HDR
HDR10
HLG
DolbyVision
HDRVivid
SDR+
Case-insensitive.
Leave this parameter empty for non-HDR videos
parameters.help_zh:
转码流HDR类型。取值：
HDR
HDR10
HLG
DolbyVision
HDRVivid
SDR+
大小写不敏感。
非HDR视频该参数为空即可
parameters.name: hdr_type

parameters.help_en:
The custom parameter. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86952.html.
To use the message callback in this parameter, configure the HTTP callback URL and select the corresponding callback event types in the console. Otherwise, the callback settings do not take effect. For information about how to configure HTTP callbacks in the console, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86071.html
parameters.help_zh:
用户自定义参数。详情参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86952.html。
此参数中消息回调的使用前提是需要在控制台配置HTTP回调地址和勾选对应的回调事件类型才能使用，否则回调设置不生效。控制台配置HTTP回调的操作，请参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86071.html
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en:
The metadata of the media file to upload. The value is a JSON string.
For more information, see the UploadMetadata table below
parameters.help_zh:
上传媒体文件的元数据信息，为JSON字符串。
更多信息，请参见下表UploadMetadata
parameters.name: upload_metadata

FileURL.description_en: The OSS file URL of the transcoded stream

SourceURL.description_en: The input URL of the transcoded stream. This value can be used as a request parameter of the [GetURLUploadInfos]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/106830.html） operation
SourceURL.description_zh: 转码流输入URL地址。可以作为[GetURLUploadInfos]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/106830.html）接口的请求参数

StreamJobId.description_en:
The job ID of the transcoded stream. This value can be used as a request parameter of the [GetURLUploadInfos]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/106830.html） operation.

ApsaraVideo VOD uses the job ID to uniquely identify a transcoded stream file. For more information, see [Basic data types - PlayInfo]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52839.html）
StreamJobId.description_zh:
转码流JobId。可以作为[GetURLUploadInfos]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/106830.html）接口的请求参数。

点播使用JobId唯一标识一个转码流文件。详情请参考：[基本数据-PlayInfo视频播放信息]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52839.html）
